overrides.8.6.0: Ren'Py nightly built from renpy-build master; every build rebases renpylinter/8.6.0 onto the newest nightly. recipe_sha256 is not fixed here: the engine build requires the deps release's recipe to equal its checkout's.

overrides.8.4.1: Engine built against the modern baseline deps. Its own recipe differs only in freetype 2.13.1 and brotli 1.0.9 (8.5.3: 2.13.3, 1.1.0).

overrides.8.0.3: ancient: linked against the legacy layer as the plan's first attempt; compile, link and system-import gates pass, so no ancient layer was built.
